POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

POST $account.url
payload {"status": "deactivated"}
$body.status == deactivated

# A deactivated account can't be used for anything.
POST-as-GET $account.url
error == unauthorized

POST $account.url
payload {"status": "valid"}
error == unauthorized

# Nor recovered through newAccount.
POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
error == unauthorized

POST $dir.newAccount
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": true}
error == unauthorized

POST $dir.keyChange
payload {"account": "$account.url", "oldKey": $account.jwk}
sign inner bob
error == unauthorized

# Other status values are ignored.
POST $dir.newAccount as carol
payload {}
$code == 201

POST $carol.url as carol
payload {"status": "revoked"}
$body.status == valid

POST-as-GET $carol.url as carol
$body.status == valid
